full_prompt_en: A square antique photographic print shows a small group of young men in worn outdoor clothing. One central man in a flat cap and open jacket is the clearest figure, looking directly toward the camera. A second face appears behind him to the left, while other pale figures overlap faintly at the right and across the background. Their bodies dissolve into a dark, grassy lower field, and the upper part of the image is veiled by light staining and irregular paper marks. The sepia brown and cream tones feel faded rather than sharply black and white. The central face and cap retain enough detail to show a serious expression, but nearby outlines blur and double as though several moments were exposed together. No precise setting is visible beyond a suggestion of outdoor vegetation. Light is broad and soft, brightening the upper background and leaving the lower bodies in brown shadow. Paper fibers, scratches, patches and uneven chemical density are as visible as the people themselves. The composition is frontal and roughly centered, but ghostly overlapping faces make its space uncertain. A warm beige margin and mottled surface turn the photograph into a fragile historical object. The image feels intimate and unstable, with one clear gaze held among fading traces of others.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形古旧摄影印片呈现一小组穿磨旧户外衣服的年轻男子。中央一人戴平顶帽、穿敞开的外套，最为清楚，直视镜头。左后方出现第二张面孔，右侧和背景还有其他浅淡身影互相重叠。身体消散进下方深色草地，上半部分被浅色污渍和不规则纸痕遮罩。深褐与奶油色显得褪色，而非清脆黑白。中央面孔和帽子仍有足够细节显示严肃神情，邻近轮廓却模糊并重影，像数个时刻一同曝光。除隐约户外植被外，看不出准确地点。光宽阔柔软，抬亮上方背景，让下半身留在棕影中。纸纤维、刮痕、色斑和不均匀化学密度与人物一样可见。构图正面且大致居中，但幽灵般叠脸使空间不确定。暖米色边缘与斑驳表面把照片变成脆弱历史物件。画面亲近却不稳定，一道清楚目光被保持在其他人渐淡的痕迹之间。
style_prompt_en: The calotype-like print has soft sepia contrast, uneven exposure and visible paper fibers. Warm cream highlights fade into brown and charcoal patches without crisp digital edges. Ghosted overlapping shapes and scratches make depth uncertain, while one slightly clearer center anchors the frame. Broad diffuse illumination leaves shadows porous rather than solid. Stains, grain and irregular borders give the image a fragile historical character.
style_prompt_zh: 这种卡罗式印片有柔和深褐对比、不均匀曝光和可见纸纤维。暖奶油亮面淡入棕与炭色色斑，没有清脆数字边缘。重影形状和刮痕使深度不确定，一个略清楚的中心固定画面。宽阔漫光让阴影多孔而非实心。污渍、颗粒与不规则边框赋予图像脆弱历史质感。
theme_en: A faded calotype group portrait with overlapping exposures
theme_zh: 重叠曝光的褪色卡罗式人物合影
name: Calotype print
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
